speaker: josias_thwaite
text: And fourteenthly, brethren, the parish turns now toward Lent.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Septuagesima is a counting of days. The fast is not yet. The glass will keep its own time.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: We shall be brief.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He says brief, and the glass has already gone over once. It will go again. It always does.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am counting the turns, Mistress. Not the heads in the pews.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Lent comes on after Shrove Tuesday, brethren. Turn the house toward it before the week turns you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He has said Lent. That is what I came to hear.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. He has not said starch. That is the mercy of a February morning.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The flesh is not yet forbidden, brethren. Friday is Friday. The rest of a week is still a table.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He has not numbered the days, Master Shakespeare. I will not number them for him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I do not want a number. I wanted the name of the fast, and I have it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Shrove Tuesday, and then the house turns. A parish can say it without a playbill.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will hear it here. Sir John is three rows ahead. He has not turned, and he has not spoken to me.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He does not speak to you. A furred back is the whole of him, from this pew. Leave him.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: And fourteenthly, the glass is not your master. I turn it so that I may see I have been long.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have been long, Master Thwaite. The second turn is the one I came to count.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And still no starch. I am grateful for a small mercy, since the large one is Lent.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Starch is not the doctrine, mistress. Lent is. Take the name home to the table. Do not bring the table in here.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We will take the name home. I have nothing to add to a sermon.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. Dinner is across the close, and the Mayor's house is not on the way to it.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: And the same fourteenthly I leave with you, to be remembered at your tables.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Remembered, then. Lent is named. The fast is not yet. That is a morning.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: Then go to your table, and keep Friday when Friday comes. I have turned the glass twice. I am done.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: We are going. Come, Master Shakespeare. The loaf will not measure itself.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am coming. Thank you, Master Thwaite. You have given me the word I came for.
